initial_decision.brief_rationale: The population table establishes an observed risk difference of -0.10. The checks verify arithmetic but do not establish causal identification. Request the archived design record to assess whether its design information identifies the average causal risk difference.

final_decision.brief_rationale: The observational design supplies consistency and no interference but no condition identifying the missing counterfactual risks. The observed risk difference of -0.10 is descriptive; the average causal risk difference is not uniquely identified.
